units.source_text: “难道我遇见了小姐的幻影，在同千重子小姐的幻影说话吗？

en.t: Could it be that I have met the young lady's phantom, and am speaking with Miss Chieko's phantom?

units.source_text: 在祇园节上会出现幻影吗？”

en.t: Do phantoms appear at the Gion Festival?"

units.source_text: 但是，秀男却没有说是“意中人”的幻影。

en.t: However, Hideo did not say it was the phantom of the person he loved.
